body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013') - Tel79 Communication ( President, Ji Yong-Hwa, www.talknow.co.kr) unveiled its integrated communication platform solution based on XMPP(Extensible Messaging and presence Protocol), 'TALKNOW UC' at the world's largest electronics exhibition, CES 2013.
'TALK NOW UC' has favorable notice in CES 2013 that it increased efficiency by having spoken-dialog, voice chatting in anywhere, at anytime.
It features prominently in video conference and various solutions like web-mail, web hard, group ware, ERP. And different customizing solutions are available due to its remote control functions.
'TALKNOW UC' supports to check organization chart , announcement and have a business contacts easily. Also it simplifies decision making and discussion process with headphones only.

Especially, It helps quick meeting progress by supporting electric black board function that enables talking, drawing and writing at the same time. Also it maintains internal security with their own ID provided.

Ji,Yong-Hwa, President of Tel79 Communication said " TALKNOW participated in CES 2013 to maximize global market, we pursue to find business and solution subcontractor. Also we are planning to attend 'MWC 2013' on February."

(Photo description: Tel79 Communication made a favorable professional mentoring progress with a support of 'KOCCA' Smart Contents center. Patrick Chung, who was used to work at SK TELECOM VENTURES, and works for RIMON.P.C(LAW FIRM ENVOLVED) at present, progressed this program with 3 global mentoring program professionals.)
